userStories.title: Remove the nax prompts command
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Replace the entire `nax prompts` implementation, including `--init` and `--export`, with a config-free removal stub and delete its exclusive CLI modules. **Motivation** — After B2b-3 the only production path into the pipeline prompt code is `nax prompts`. **Approach** — Design Part 1: the `nax prompts` command. Paths in this design table are below `packages/nax/src/` unless prefixed `bin/` or `scripts/`. | Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `bin/nax.ts:1371-1451` | the `prompts` command keeps its name and option list (`-f/--feature`, `--init`, `--export <role>`, `--force`, `--story <id>`, `--out <path>`, `-d/--dir <path>`) with plain `option` calls, description `Removed: workflow mode does not read prompt templates`, and an action that prints `nax prompts was removed: workflow mode does not read prompt templates` in red to stderr and exits 1, reading no config, no PRD and no trust state; same shape as the `accept` stub at `:1355-1369` |
| `bin/nax.ts:52`, `:58`, `:59` | `exportPromptCommand`, `promptsCommand` and `promptsInitCommand` leave the `../src/cli` import |
| `cli/index.ts:176-184` | the `./prompts` re-export block goes |
| `cli/init.ts:434` | the `Optional: nax prompts --init` hint line goes |
| `scripts/check-worktree-id-ssot.ts:94` | the `src/cli/prompts-init.ts` entry goes |

Deleted, under `cli/`: `prompts.ts`, `prompts-export.ts`, `prompts-init.ts`, `prompts-main.ts`, `prompts-shared.ts`, `prompts-tdd.ts`. **Scope** — In: the removal action, CLI imports/barrel/hint, six CLI source deletions, obsolete tests/allowlists and the new real-binary integration. Delete unit CLI prompts-export/init/main/tdd tests and integration/prompts/pb-004-migration.test.ts. Remove only the two prompts cases from cli-trust-gate.test.ts and the obsolete title phrase in unit/cli/init.test.ts, retaining all other trust and no-template-scaffolding assertions. Out: US-002's prompt stage/builders, US-003's leaves, US-004's plugin optimizer, US-005's mutation subsystem, US-006's orphan declarations; Config keys and their schemas, defaults, merge handling, migrations and descriptions: `optimizer.*` (with the `_applyRemovedOptimizerKeysShim` shim), `prompts.overrides` (with `PROMPT_OVERRIDE_ROLES`, the precheck override-file warning in `precheck/checks-warnings.ts` and the `prompts.overrides` lines in `cli/config-display.ts` and `cli/config-descriptions.ts`), `execution.mutationCheck` and the `advisor.callers` flags; wave B3 decides them. Docs and package context files that describe `nax prompts`, prompt overrides, `IPromptOptimizer`, `src/optimizer/` or mutation testing (`docs/guides/prompt-customization.md`, `docs/guides/cli-reference.md`, the `.nax/context.md` files and the `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` files generated from them); `.nax/` is read-only to the run, so they are updated in wave B4. **Interface** — Keep the command name `prompts` and the former options as plain `option` calls; its action takes no project initialization path. `prompts --help` is Commander's successful help path, not the removal action. No replacement prompt-generation API is introduced. **Verification** — Create `packages/nax/test/integration/cli/cli-prompts-removed.test.ts`, following the accept-removed real-bin pattern: absolute bin path, empty temporary cwd, concurrent pipe draining and exit wait, cleanup. Exercise the full option combination, no options, directory emptiness and command help. Also use the existing isolated NAX_GLOBAL_CONFIG_DIR test pattern with malformed project config, feature PRD and trust.json to assert the removal message is the entire normalized stderr; do not change the trust gate for any other command.
